title: How Gallagher Restoration Can Save Turkey Day
excerpt: Thanksgiving is one of the most common days for household emergencies. Here is what usually goes wrong — and how to keep the holiday on track.
author: Aaron Gallagher
imageAlt: Thanksgiving dinner table setting representing holiday household emergency preparedness

body.text: Thanksgiving is a time for family, gratitude, and plenty of delicious food. It is also one of the most common days for household emergencies — kitchen fires, plumbing failures, and appliance breakdowns spike during the holiday. Here is what usually goes wrong and what to do about it.
Big meals mean a busy kitchen, and the kitchen is the most common place for holiday fires.

items: Overloaded electrical outlets from countertop appliances.

body.text: Pro tip: keep a fire extinguisher nearby and never throw water on a grease fire. If a kitchen fire gets away from you, Gallagher Restoration can clean up smoke damage, remove soot, and restore your kitchen to its pre-loss condition.
With a house full of guests, your plumbing works overtime.
Our water damage team is on call to quickly extract water, dry out your home, and prevent mold growth.
From refrigerators storing all the extra food to garbage disposals struggling with Thanksgiving scraps, appliances break down when you need them most.

items: Washing machine overflows from post-dinner tablecloth loads.

body.text: Mold isn't an immediate emergency, but it grows fast after a leak. A small leak that goes unnoticed during the holiday hustle turns into a bigger problem within days. Our mold remediation team locates, removes, and prevents mold from spreading.
Emergencies don't take holidays off. Our team is available 24/7, even on Thanksgiving.

items: Fast response times. On-site within an hour to minimize damage.
Experienced professionals. IICRC-certified crews equipped for water, fire, and mold restoration.
Customer-first service. We work directly with insurance companies to keep the process stress-free.

body.text: Steps to take in an emergency

items: Ensure safety. Evacuate the area if necessary and call 911 for fires or major plumbing issues.
Call Gallagher Restoration. Our 24/7 line will dispatch help immediately.
Minimize damage. Turn off water or electricity if safe to do so.
Document everything. Take photos of the damage for insurance.
